{{quotation|game|Centuries ago the city of [[Moladune]] is said to have lain here in the southern Shiverpeak Mountains. A shining palace of ice and stone, legends say that it stood for thousands of years, then fell one bright dawn in a single earthshaking crash, leaving behind no sign of its inhabitants. Today, the mines are the only sign that the city might once have been more than myth.}}

[[Iron Mines of Moladune (outpost)|Iron Mines of Moladune]] is a [[mission]] [[outpost]]. It is a small dwarven settlement with a corral for [[Dolyak]]s in the center, and dwarven buildings around the perimeter.

==Getting There==
*The mission [[Ice Caves of Sorrow]] will bring you here.
*From the west, via the [[Frozen Forest]], starting at either [[Droknar's Forge]], [[Ice Caves of Sorrow (outpost)|Ice Caves of Sorrow]], [[Deldrimor War Camp]], or [[Copperhammer Mines]].

==Mission==
*[[Iron Mines of Moladune]]
**This mission is the twenty first mission in the [[Prophecies campaign]] and the second mission in the [[Southern Shiverpeaks ]] region.
